title: The Death of Nadab and Abihu

questions.question: Who were Nadab and Abihu?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 10:1 (ESV): "Now Nadab and Abihu, the sons of Aaron..."

questions.question: What sin did Nadab and Abihu commit?
options: They offered unauthorized fire before the Lord
questions.correctAnswer: They offered unauthorized fire before the Lord
questions.explanation: Leviticus 10:1 (ESV): "And offered unauthorized fire before the Lord, which he had not commanded them."

questions.question: How did Nadab and Abihu die?
options: Fire came out from before the Lord and consumed them
questions.correctAnswer: Fire came out from before the Lord and consumed them
questions.explanation: Leviticus 10:2 (ESV): "And fire came out from before the Lord and consumed them, and they died before the Lord."

questions.question: What command did God give Aaron regarding wine and strong drink?
options: Do not drink wine or strong drink when you go into the tent of meeting
questions.correctAnswer: Do not drink wine or strong drink when you go into the tent of meeting
questions.explanation: Leviticus 10:9 (ESV): "Drink no wine or strong drink, you or your sons with you, when you go into the tent of meeting, lest you die."

questions.question: What were Aaron and his remaining sons forbidden to do after the death of Nadab and Abihu?
options: Let their hair become unkempt or tear their clothes
questions.correctAnswer: Let their hair become unkempt or tear their clothes
questions.explanation: Leviticus 10:6 (ESV): "Do not let the hair of your heads hang loose, and do not tear your clothes, lest you die."

questions.question: Who carried the bodies of Nadab and Abihu outside the camp?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 10:4 (ESV): "And Moses called Mishael and Elzaphan, the sons of Uzziel the uncle of Aaron... carry your brothers... outside the camp."

questions.question: What is a primary duty of the priests distinguished in this chapter?
options: To distinguish between the holy and the common, and between the unclean and the clean
questions.correctAnswer: To distinguish between the holy and the common, and between the unclean and the clean
questions.explanation: Leviticus 10:10 (ESV): "You are to distinguish between the holy and the common, and between the unclean and the clean."

questions.question: Where were Aaron and his sons to eat the grain offering?
options: Beside the altar in a holy place
questions.correctAnswer: Beside the altar in a holy place
questions.explanation: Leviticus 10:12 (ESV): "Eat it unleavened beside the altar, for it is most holy."

questions.question: Who were Aaron's remaining sons?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 10:6 (ESV): "And Moses said to Aaron and to Eleazar and Ithamar his surviving sons..."

questions.question: Why was Moses angry with Eleazar and Ithamar?
options: They burned the goat of the sin offering instead of eating it in a holy place
They entered the Holy of Holies
questions.correctAnswer: They burned the goat of the sin offering instead of eating it in a holy place
questions.explanation: Leviticus 10:16-17 (ESV): "Behold, it was burned. And he was angry... Why have you not eaten the sin offering in the place of the sanctuary...?"

questions.question: What reason did Aaron give for not eating the sin offering?
options: Such things have happened to me; would it have been approved by the Lord?
questions.correctAnswer: Such things have happened to me; would it have been approved by the Lord?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 10:19 (ESV): "Such things as these have happened to me! If I had eaten the sin offering today, would it have been approved in the sight of the Lord?"

questions.question: How did Moses respond to Aaron's explanation?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 10:20 (ESV): "And when Moses heard that, he approved."

questions.question: Who was allowed to bewail the burning that the Lord had kindled?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 10:6 (ESV): "But your brothers, the whole house of Israel, may bewail the burning that the Lord has kindled."

questions.question: What specific parts of the peace offering were given to the priests as a due?
options: The breast that is waved and the thigh that is contributed
questions.correctAnswer: The breast that is waved and the thigh that is contributed
questions.explanation: Leviticus 10:14 (ESV): "The breast that is waved and the thigh that is contributed you shall eat in a clean place."

questions.question: Why were the priests normally required to eat the sin offering?
options: To bear the iniquity of the congregation and make atonement
questions.correctAnswer: To bear the iniquity of the congregation and make atonement
questions.explanation: Leviticus 10:17 (ESV): "He has given it to you to bear the iniquity of the congregation, to make atonement for them before the Lord."

key_verse_text: Among those who are near me I will be sanctified, and before all the people I will be glorified.
